## 問題
2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 以 shipments 表 shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的 11128 筆出貨紀錄計算，配送天數定義為 julianday(delivered_ts) − julianday(shipped_ts)，跨所有 carrier 合併求平均。排除 1181 筆 delivered_ts 為空（尚未送達）的紀錄，無負值資料。語意層未解析到相關概念，定義依資料表欄位直接推得。
SQL 1: SELECT carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts LIKE '2025-04%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-05%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-06%' LIMIT 20
  結果: {'columns': ['carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts'], 'rows': [['post', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55'], ['blackcat', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51'], ['blackcat', '2025-04-12 17:13:13', '2025-04-14 18:13:13'], ['blackcat', '2025-05-15 04:04:09', '2025-05-16 09:04:09'], 
SQL 2: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts) < julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_days FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['avg_delivery_days', 'total_rows', 'null_delivered', 'negative_days'], 'rows': [[2.91, 11128, 1181, 0]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層的時區規則，將 orders.order_ts 加 8 小時換算為台北時間後，取 2025-04-01 至 2025-07-01 之間的訂單，並連結 shipments。配送天數定義為 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以天為單位），僅計入已送達的 9921 筆（總筆數 11112）。驗證結果：無負值、無空出貨時間，且每筆 shipment 對應不同訂單。
SQL 1: SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, typeof(s.delivered_ts) AS t FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10
  結果: {'columns': ['shipment_id', 'carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts', 'order_ts', 't'], 'rows': [[1, 'post', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55', '2025-05-27 02:32:55', 'text'], [2, 'blackcat', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51', '2025-06-01 06:04:51', 'text'], [3, 'hct', '2025-09-
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(s.delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  結果: {'columns': ['n_total', 'n_delivered', 'avg_delivery_days'], 'rows': [[11112, 9921, 2.91]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 3: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_negative, MIN(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_negative, MIN(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS min_days,

response: {"winner": "tie", "reason": "兩者答案同為 2.91 且都排除未送達紀錄：A 以 shipped_ts 篩選第二季，較貼近配送指標的語意，但未處理時區；B 套用語意層的台北時區規則並多做驗證，卻改以訂單時間歸屬季度，兩者各有可議之處、整體相當。", "critical_error": false}
